name: Strategy Inc
tagline: The world's first and largest Bitcoin Treasury Company
hero_kpi_rationale: MSTR's core identity and value driver is its massive bitcoin treasury, which defines its financial strategy and market positioning. The scale of its bitcoin holdings directly impacts shareholder value and distinguishes it from all other tech firms.
